sentences.text: M C P, short for Model Context Protocol, is an open protocol that lets a server offer tools and resources to any compatible agent.
Think of it as a universal plug.
One server can be used from Copilot Studio and from other compatible clients, and the agent only reads which tools the server offers.
In Copilot Studio, the only transport allowed is Streamable H T T P.
The older S S E transport has not been supported since August twenty twenty-five, so a server that only offers S S E will not work.
Check this first, because it is a classic exam trap.
After that, there are two ways to connect a server.
The recommended way is the wizard.
Go to Tools, Add a tool, New tool, Model Context Protocol.
You type a name, a description, and the U R L of the server.
The orchestrator reads the description to decide when to call the server, so write it clearly.
Remember, M C P also needs generative orchestration turned on.
Authentication can be none, A P I key, or O Auth two point zero.
O Auth has three modes: Dynamic discovery, Dynamic, and Manual.
The other way to connect is a custom connector built from an Open A P I file, where the operation is marked with x M S agentic protocol.
Then you create the connection.
After the connection, you choose Add to agent.
Because M C P uses Power Platform connectors, data policies, also called D L P, govern M C P servers too.
That is how a security team blocks servers that are not approved.
And remember, the tools are chosen by the orchestrator, so generative orchestration is required.
